title: Biingi Mabeopsonyeodo Yeonaehal Su Innayo
synonyms: Can Unpopular Magical Girls Also Date?
synopsis: Chae-Na, who plays the unpopular Clover in [Magical Lucky Stars], the group that protects Madeleine Village. She feels weak and inadequate as a hero, so she lives inconspicuously and endures being an unpopular member. She feels uncomfortable and awkward being in the spotlight. However, there is someone who falls in love with her at first sight after seeing her kindness! It is Red, a popular member of the [Transcendental Sentai Hyperranger] group that protects the neighboring Galaxy Village, Seung-Chan. "I fell in love at first sight. I think I like you!" She is excited by the appearance of Red, whom she admires, but refuses to confess, saying that she doesn't even know what kind of person she is... After hearing the heart-fluttering words that she doesn't know anything about you and wants to get to know you more, she eventually runs away. "There's no way such a cool person would like someone like me. There must be some kind of mistake!" A heart-fluttering story of a super popular hero and an unpopular magical girl who accepts his confession. (Source: Peanutoon, translated)

There, he was discovered by the owner of "Tomikyu," a long-established ryotei restaurant in Ginza, where he underwent rigorous training, eventually becoming the head chef at Tomikyu. After that, he went on a culinary journey until he opened his own restaurant, "Tomikyu Kamui" in Nerima, Tokyo. A few years later, Sota is back at it again, this time to pursue the essence of "Omotenashi" (hospitality), just in time for the 2020 Tokyo Olympics! The long-awaited revival of the classic culinary manga! (Source: Bunkasha, translated)
